name: Doug's Existential Potato Paradox
source:
This game is a Visual novel about a young man becoming a potato. Doug is a 19 year old man working at Potato Palace. 
Some strange occurrences started happening to Doug. Now he is turning into a potato. Time is short, you must find Doug a suitable fate. Can you make Doug stand the test of time? Doug can go skydiving or rob a bank. Find all potato related endings.
translation:
这是一部关于年轻男人变成土豆的视觉小说。道格19岁，在土豆宫工作。

道格开始遭遇奇怪事件，如今正在变成土豆。时间紧迫，你必须为道格找到合适的命运。你能让道格经受时间考验吗？道格可以跳伞，也可以抢银行。找出所有与土豆有关的结局。
